info.title: FlowKey API
info.description:
FlowKey — NGN digital wallet platform.

## Base URL
`https://flowkey-api.onrender.com/api/v1`

## Authentication
All protected endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.

Access tokens expire after 15 minutes. Use `POST /auth/refresh` to get a new one before expiry. Every token response includes `access_token_expires_at` (ISO timestamp) — use this to schedule proactive refresh at ~2 minutes before expiry so users are never interrupted.

## Idempotency
All mutating endpoints (POST/DELETE that create or modify data) require an `Idempotency-Key: <uuid-v4>` header. Duplicate requests with the same key return the original response without re-executing.

## Monetary values
All amounts in **kobo** (integer). `amount / 100 = naira`. Always returned as strings to avoid float precision issues.

## Error format
All errors follow:
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "data": null,
  "meta": null,
  "error": { "code": "ERROR_CODE", "message": "Human readable message" }
}
```

## Common error codes
| Code | HTTP | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Missing or invalid Bearer token |
| `TOKEN_EXPIRED` | 401 | Access token expired — call /auth/refresh |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | Authenticated but not allowed |
| `NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Resource not found |
| `CONFLICT` | 409 | Duplicate or state conflict |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 422 | Request body failed validation |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | 429 | Too many requests |
| `EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR` | 503 | Payment processor temporarily unavailable |

post.description:
Start registration. Sends a 6-digit OTP to the provided phone or email. Returns a `registration_id` used in all subsequent steps.

If a pending registration already exists for the contact, it is reused and a fresh OTP is sent.
Set username and passcode to activate the account. Returns auth tokens.
Exchange a refresh token for a new access token. Call this proactively ~2 minutes before `access_token_expires_at`. Sliding window — each refresh extends the refresh token expiry by another 30 days.

Re-authenticate after the app screen-locks. User enters their 6-digit passcode — no OTP, no contact lookup. Returns a new token pair.

Use when the app is reopened after being idle longer than your lock threshold (typically 5 minutes).

Fails after too many wrong attempts — the session is revoked and the user must do a full login.

refresh_token.description: The stored refresh token for this device session

401.description: Wrong passcode or session not found.

403.description: Too many wrong attempts — session revoked. User must log in again.

get.description:
Prometheus text format metrics for scraping. Exposes HTTP request rates, latency histograms, BullMQ queue depths, wallet credit counters, transfer counters, auth event counters, and Node.js runtime metrics.

Restrict access to your monitoring network in production.

text/plain.example:
# HELP http_requests_total Total number of HTTP requests
# TYPE http_requests_total counter
http_requests_total{method="GET",route="/health",status_code="200",app="flowkey-api"} 42
...

post.summary: UID transfer — FlowKey to FlowKey (from friend's device)
post.description:
Transfer money from a FlowKey wallet using Universal ID + UPP — without logging out the device owner.

Use case: you're on a friend's phone, their FlowKey session is active. You type your Universal ID and UPP to send money from your own wallet. The friend's session is untouched.

**Auth:** friend's Bearer token is required (to reach the API). Sender is resolved from `universal_id` + `upp` — not from the session.

**UPP (Universal Payment PIN):** 6-digit PIN set in your own FlowKey app under Settings.

201.description: Transfer completed. Sender's wallet is debited. Device owner's wallet is untouched.

403.description: Wrong UPP, UPP locked, or sender account inactive.

409.description: Insufficient balance, daily limit exceeded, or UPP not set.

post.summary: UID transfer — FlowKey to Bank (from friend's device)
post.description:
Initiate a bank transfer from a FlowKey wallet using Universal ID + UPP on any device.

Same model as `/transfers/uid/internal` but sends to a Nigerian bank account.

201.description: Transfer initiated (pending). Sender's wallet debited immediately.

post.description:
Request money from another FlowKey user. They receive a notification and can pay, decline, or let it expire.

Receiver identified by username, Universal ID (e.g. RIVER-CLOUD-SEVEN), or wallet UUID.

Expires after 24 hours by default (max 72h).

receiver_identifier.description: Username, Universal ID, or wallet UUID of the recipient

403.description: Wrong PIN, insufficient balance, or you are not the receiver.

409.description: Request already paid, declined, cancelled, or expired.

post.description: Only the receiver can decline. No money moves.

403.description: You are not the receiver of this request.

409.description: Request is not in pending state.

409.description: Request is not in pending state.

get.description: Returns all feature flags and their current values. Protected by `X-Admin-Key` header.

put.summary: Enable or disable a feature flag
put.description:
Toggle a feature flag at runtime — no deployment required. Takes effect within 5 seconds (cache TTL).

Emergency kill switch: `PUT /admin/flags/transfers.bank { "enabled": false }` halts all bank transfers instantly.

delete.summary: Reset a feature flag to its default
delete.description: Deletes the flag from Redis so it falls back to the code default.
